title: Fix AVP decryption in Radius dissector
description:
- Add support for RFC2868 decryption
- Add support for ascend decryption
- Allow decryption of non-string AVP's
- Fixes issue [19396](https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/19396)

Hmm, that could happen if there would be a tagged and encrypted integer or signed in the radius dictionary (there isn't currently). Proposed fix:

``` 
diff --git a/epan/dissectors/packet-radius.c b/epan/dissectors/packet-radius.c
index 3708321c0e..3ba1002665 100644
--- a/epan/dissectors/packet-radius.c
+++ b/epan/dissectors/packet-radius.c
@@ -2401,6 +2401,7 @@ register_attrs(gpointer k _U_, gpointer v, gpointer p)
                { NULL, { NULL, NULL, FT_NONE,  BASE_NONE, NULL, 0x0, NULL, HFILL }},
                { NULL, { NULL, NULL, FT_UINT8, BASE_DEC, NULL, 0x0, NULL, HFILL }},
                { NULL, { NULL, NULL, FT_NONE,  BASE_NONE, NULL, 0x0, NULL, HFILL }},
+               { NULL, { NULL, NULL, FT_NONE,  BASE_NONE, NULL, 0x0, NULL, HFILL }},
                { NULL, { NULL, NULL, FT_NONE,  BASE_NONE, NULL, 0x0, NULL, HFILL }}
        };
        guint len_hf = 2;
Created merge request wireshark/wireshark!13174 to fix this.
